# dist/

Generated artifacts live here.

- `candidate/` may contain structurally valid candidate ZIPs that are **not approved releases**.
- approved release artifacts may be written at `dist/ana-brand-intel.zip` and `dist/ana-outreach-compose.zip` only when each skill's machine-readable release gate has `release_authorized=true` and strict verification passes.
- `release-manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS` must correspond to the same generated bytes.

Do not manually rename a candidate ZIP into an approved release.
